abstract: Regulates on-site water filtration, purification systems, and reserves
system_message:
You are the Environmental water authority lead (WATR). Your primary business responsibilities include regulating and documenting on-site water filtration, purification systems, independent potable water treatment status, and raw water storage reserves across designated municipal shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Raw water storage reserves（STOR）
information_points.content:
WATR-STOR-9UC：For the Centennial Exhibition Pavilion, the total volumetric untreated water reserve capacity within dedicated underground reserve tanks is 60,000 L.
WATR-STOR-B53：For the Riverside Logistics Complex, the total volumetric untreated water reserve capacity within dedicated underground reserve tanks is 30,000 L.
WATR-STOR-ICU：For the Northwestern Sports Arena, the total volumetric untreated water reserve capacity within dedicated underground reserve tanks is 45,000 L.

information_points.title: Regulates on-site water filtration, purification systems, and reserves（AQUA）
information_points.content:
WATR-AQUA-IES：For the Centennial Exhibition Pavilion, independent water purification clearance is documented as false under an assessment basis exclusive of emergency reserve storage circulation, based on on-site reverse osmosis water filtration unit testing.
WATR-AQUA-HWP：For the Riverside Logistics Complex, independent water purification clearance is confirmed as true under an assessment basis inclusive of emergency reserve storage circulation, demonstrating that on-site reverse osmosis filtration meets all required microbiological safety criteria.
WATR-AQUA-AYT：For the Centennial Exhibition Pavilion, independent water purification clearance is confirmed as true under an assessment basis inclusive of emergency reserve storage circulation, verifying that output from the on-site reverse osmosis filtration unit satisfies microbiological safety standards.
WATR-AQUA-IOU：For the Northwestern Sports Arena, independent water purification clearance is false under an assessment basis inclusive of emergency reserve storage circulation, as on-site reverse osmosis water filtration output does not satisfy microbiological safety standards across reserve storage.
